effectEntries.effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.
effectEntries.shortEffect: When Terapagos enters the battle, it turns into its Terastal Form until the end of the battle.

descriptions.text: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.
Quand le Pokémon rejoint le combat, il absorbe\nl’énergie alentour et prend sa Forme Téracristal.
